sections.name: File setup, CommonModule
sections.title: Shared infrastructure bundle
sections.what: Connects the database, Redis, file storage, audit logging, and the background job queue into one shared module, using a Redis URL when provided or separate host settings otherwise.
sections.why: Likely reason: many features need these services, so they are shared in one place.
sections.watch_out: Redis settings are read in two places, so changes must be made in both.

summary: A global module that bundles the shared services: database, Redis, file storage, audit logging, and the background job queue.
purpose: Gives every feature access to shared infrastructure without importing each piece separately.
why: Marked global, so the shared services are available everywhere. Likely reason: most features need these services.
how: 1) Import the database, Redis, and storage modules. 2) Set up the background job queue, using a Redis address if one is given, or host, port, password, and database settings otherwise. 3) Provide and export the audit service and the shared pieces.
inputs: REDIS_URL, or REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_PASSWORD, and REDIS_DB.
outputs: Shared services available to other modules.
risks: REDIS_URL is read here but is missing from the example settings file. The queue settings duplicate those in the Redis module, so they can drift apart. An empty password is treated as no password.
debug: If background jobs do not run, check the Redis settings and whether Redis is reachable. If the URL and the host settings disagree, check which one is set.
